title: Fizz Buzz
statement: Implement `solve(n)`. Return a list of strings for the numbers 1 through `n` inclusive. A multiple of both 3 and 5 is `FizzBuzz`. A multiple of 3 only is `Fizz`. A multiple of 5 only is `Buzz`. Every other number is its decimal representation. Check the combined case before the single divisors.
hints: Test divisible by 15, or by 3 and by 5, before the single tests.
Convert the plain numbers with str.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: If the 3 test comes first, 15 becomes Fizz and the combined branch is dead.

editorial: If the 3 test comes first, 15 becomes Fizz and the combined branch is dead. The order of the conditions is the algorithm. 15 is the least common multiple, so one modulo handles the intersection.
